verdict.rationale: Close's developer portal documents full endpoint docs with schemas, examples, and an interactive API explorer, backed by a published OpenAPI spec that a probe confirmed is live. That covers the core of an interactive, example-rich API reference. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that examples can be executed in-browser (try-it requests with auth), and hands-on or independent corroboration of the explorer's behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Full endpoint docs with schemas, examples, and an interactive API explorer.
We publish an OpenAPI spec at: https://api.close.com/api/openapi.json
